_comment: UNVERIFIED - see JUDGE-TRANSPORT.md ('Local model (Ollama or LM Studio)'). This machine has neither Ollama nor LM Studio installed, so this exact invocation was never run end to end against a real local model. It runs guard-judge-local-model-wrapper.ps1 (repo root, a small PowerShell script - PowerShell ships with Windows already, nothing new to install for the wrapper itself), which talks to a local Ollama server by default. Before pointing a real session at this: (1) install Ollama from https://ollama.com/download and run 'ollama pull llama3.2' once from a terminal, (2) edit the '-File' argument below to the wrapper script's actual absolute path on your machine, (3) confirm it works with 'echo hello | powershell -NoProfile -File guard-judge-local-model-wrapper.ps1' - it should print a few lines of model text, not an error. This file is never read from its example name; copy it to guard-judge-config.json beside the store (same folder as thor.db) to activate it.
